peopleAlsoAsk: What is the flavor of tom yum noodles?
What does tom yum taste like?

items.markdown:
![Thai Tom Yum Noodle Soup | Marion's Kitchen](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280843-1672-0139-0000-7e3b51109477:4)
Tom yum noodles refer to `any type of noodle dish—ranging from street-style rice noodles to instant ramen—prepared in the iconic Thai "tom yum" style` . Characterized by a vibrant, hot and sour flavor profile, this style balances heat, tanginess, and savory depth using lemongrass, kaffir lime, galangal, and fish sauce.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/soupless-tom-yum-noodles/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/soupless-tom-yum-noodles/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_yum)[[3]](https://thai-foodie.com/thaifood/tom-yum-soup-noodles-with-tom-yum-paste/)

The Two Main Styles

- **Noodle Soup (Tom Yum Goong/Moo):** This features classic aromatics simmered into a rich, flavorful broth, typically served with thin rice noodles, shrimp, pork, mushrooms, and cilantro.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/soupless-tom-yum-noodles/) 
- **Soupless Noodles (Tom Yum Haeng):** A popular Thai street food hidden gem where noodles are tossed without broth. They are mixed directly with lime juice, roasted chili flakes, ground peanuts, and garlic oil, and then topped with ground meat.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/soupless-tom-yum-noodles/) [[1]](https://www.facebook.com/HotThaiKitchen/videos/dry-noodles-is-the-hidden-menu-item-at-most-thai-noodle-soup-vendors-instead-of-/1159915529493748/)

Instant Tom Yum Noodles Globally, the phrase often refers to packaged instant noodles. Brands like *Mama* (famous for its creamy shrimp flavor) are immensely popular for their highly authentic, quick, and convenient flavor. You can easily pick these up or order takeout from local Thai noodle bars.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:5923323983172272493,catalogid:14385253911353900385,gpcid:5857385857229104619,mid:576462832660465203&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.thai-food-online.co.uk/products/cup-noodle-shrimp-tom-yum-mama)[[3]](https://www.koreafoods.co.uk/product/mama-noodle-creamy-shrimp-tom-yum-90g/)[[4]](https://www.thaifooddirect.co.uk/brands/mama/)[[5]](https://www.piccantino.ch/en-CH/mama-instant-asian-meals/instant-noodles-shrimp-tom-yum-creamy)How to Make Them at Home You can easily recreate the classic tom yum noodle experience right in your kitchen:

1. **The Base:** Combine chicken or vegetable broth with authentic [Tom Yum Paste](https://khinskitchen.com/tom-yum-soup-noodles/) to instantly achieve the signature lemongrass and galangal foundation.[](https://thai-foodie.com/thaifood/tom-yum-soup-noodles-with-tom-yum-paste/) [[1]](https://khinskitchen.com/tom-yum-soup-noodles/)
2. **The Adjustments:** To customize the sweet-salty-spicy-sour balance, add a splash of fish sauce, fresh lime juice, sugar, and chili oil.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/soupless-tom-yum-noodles/) 
3. **The Extras:** Toss in proteins like boiled shrimp or sliced chicken, bean sprouts, and chopped cilantro. For an authentic street-food twist, try adding crushed roasted peanuts![](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/soupless-tom-yum-noodles/) [[1]](https://www.tiktok.com/@hotthaikitchen/video/7620481616116272391)[[2]](https://atasteofthaiandmore.wordpress.com/2016/09/15/tom-yum-101-thai-spicy-and-sour-soup/)[[3]](https://www.verytastyworld.com/noodle-review-mama-instant-noodles/)
